description: Behavioral contract executed against the exact locked @deepseek-ai/cordis entry recorded in testbed-runtime-anchor/v2. Every case asserts real runtime semantics; no fixture or app.asar runtime may satisfy this suite.

actions: import the exact anchor entry as an ES module
check the exported Cordis class surface and construct a root Context
load tests/fixtures/fake-cordis-stub.mjs and probe the same surface
expected: the real package exports Context, Fiber, Service, EventsService, RegistryService, CordisError and ValidationError
Context.is() recognises a constructed root context with registry/events services
the fake-cordis-stub does not satisfy that surface, so it cannot be substituted for the locked runtime

actions: register ordered listeners with ctx.on while a fiber is active
dispatch with ctx.emit, ctx.bail, ctx.serial, ctx.parallel and ctx.waterfall
dispose the owning fiber and dispatch again
expected: emit invokes every listener synchronously in registration order
bail/serial stop at the first non-null bail value
parallel awaits every listener
waterfall composes listeners around the final next callback
disposing the owner removes every listener

actions: load plugins through ctx.plugin and await their fibers
provide a service with ctx.provide and read it with ctx.get
inspect ctx.registry by keys/values/entries and delete a runtime
attempt a duplicate ctx.provide
expected: every awaited plugin is ACTIVE and registered exactly once
ctx.get returns the exact provided value
registry.size/has/get/keys/entries reflect live runtimes
registry.delete disposes the owning fiber and removes the runtime
a duplicate provide is rejected

actions: provide the same service name in the root context and two ctx.isolate() scopes
load a consumer that declares inject: ['isolated']
dispose the provider and read the consumer state again
expected: each isolation scope resolves its own service value
the consumer starts only while the injected service exists
provider disposal parks the consumer in PENDING and runs its cleanup
provider re-registration returns the consumer to ACTIVE

actions: create a fiber whose inject cannot resolve, then provide the service
observe internal/status transitions
dispose the fiber and await the disposer
call restart() and effect() after disposal
expected: state starts at PENDING (0) and reaches ACTIVE (2) only after the dependency exists
disposal emits UNLOADING (5) then DISPOSED (4) and clears uid
the disposed fiber cannot restart or create effects (INACTIVE_EFFECT)
dispose is idempotent

actions: load a plugin that throws during LOADING
await the fiber and inspect the FAILED state
call restart() on the failed fiber
observe the locked version's actual restart result
expected: startup failure rejects await() with the original error
internal/status records LOADING -> UNLOADING -> FAILED
restart() re-executes the plugin and reaches ACTIVE
the locked version's restart() promise behavior is recorded verbatim

actions: register sync, async and returned-disposer effects on one fiber
read getEffects() metadata
dispose the fiber and observe disposer ordering
abort an AbortController from a disposer
expected: labeled effects appear in getEffects()
disposers run in reverse registration order and async disposers are awaited
returned plugin disposers run before effect disposers
the abort signal is aborted and no resource survives disposal

actions: mount the real cordis-plugin-loader service
create a loader entry for a real ESM plugin module by file URL
update its config and remove the entry
expected: loader.create imports and activates the plugin
loader.update restarts the entry with the new config
loader.remove stops and unloads the entry and its service
the loader entry list is empty after removal

actions: register the real Group class as the cordis:group builtin
create a group entry containing a nested plugin entry
remove the group entry
expected: the nested entry activates and provides its own service
the group is listed as a group entry carrier
removing the group disposes the nested entry and its service

actions: mount the real cordis-plugin-timer service
start an interval and a pending timeout from a plugin that injects timer
dispose the plugin fiber
expected: interval ticks while the fiber is active
disposal clears the interval (no further ticks) and the pending timeout never fires

actions: mount the real @deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner service on a real Cordis context
define a host-half dynamic package
run it, stop it, stop it again, undefine it
expected: define mints a plugin/package identity with hasHostHalf=true
run executes the sandboxed host half and provides its service
stop disposes the host fiber, released its service and effect resources
a second stop reports not-running
undefine removes the plugin and inventory becomes empty

actions: run a dynamic host half that throws
run a package with an already-aborted AbortSignal
stop and undefine the failed plugin
expected: a throwing host half returns host-half-failed with a diagnostic
an aborted run returns cancelled without creating a fiber
stop/undefine clean up failed state and report plugin-missing or not-running afterwards
